references.text: The tent of meeting was the place where God met with Moses and spoke to him, a fixed meeting place between God and the leaders of Israel.
The glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle, and Moses and Aaron came to the tent of meeting to receive God's guidance.
Moses and Aaron entered the tent of meeting together, showing their shared leadership in serving before the Lord.
Moses and Aaron left the assembly and went to the entrance of the tent of meeting, where the glory of the Lord appeared to them.
The glory of the Lord appeared at the tent of meeting for all the people of Israel as a sign of God's presence and judgment.
Korah's rebellion led to the glory of the Lord appearing at the tent of meeting, the same place where Moses and Aaron now come.
